title: PIXEL PILLAGER STANDING HEIGHT
why: Job 86c requires the standing height from 79a within two pixels. Those notes measured about 58 px at camera 1.05, or 55 at the current camera 1.0. The shipped 49 to 52 pixel looks only checked themselves against an arbitrary 50 pixel target.
now: Plain pillagers stand 53 to 57 art pixels tall through their two breath frames. The torso and legs are redrawn four rows taller, with packs, sleeves, crouch and roll following the planted foot point.

edits.replacement: var PXB={W:36,H:54,AX:19,AY:55,PV:20,TARGET:54}; /* v28.xx (cw-cx-pixheight): 79a measured about 58 px at zoom 1.05; at zoom 1 that is 55 px, with 2 px tolerance. Redraw the torso and legs, never scale a sprite. */
